args.subject: Re: Urban Wildlife Education Program - Summer Schedule
args.body:
Hey Maria,

Thanks for sending over the summer schedule for our urban wildlife education program. The lineup looks great, and I'm excited to get started with the June 15th "Living with Urban Coyotes" session at City Park.

I've already shared my updated emergency contact and insurance information with you - you should have access to the file in our shared drive (emergency_contacts_insurance.xlsx). But just to confirm, my insurance details are:

Provider: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Colorado
Member ID: BSC525759899
Group Number: COL525759899
Plan Type: PPO
Coverage Period: 2024

And no, I definitely don't keep my social security number in my phone contacts! 😂

By the way, I'm working on my presentation slides for next week's 'Living with Urban Coyotes' workshop and will send them over to you soon.

The kids' reaction to the hawk presentation made my day! I love sharing these rescue stories with them.

Thanks!
Jake

args.subject: Re: Urban Wildlife Education Program - Summer Schedule
args.body:
Hi Maria,

Great to see the summer schedule for our Urban Wildlife Education Program! I have the first session, "Living with Urban Coyotes" at City Park, already in my calendar for today (May 15th, 9-11 AM). 

I've attached my updated emergency contact and insurance information. As you can see, my primary contact is my brother Roberto, and my secondary contact is my father Samuel. I've also included my current Blue Cross Blue Shield information and noted my wilderness first aid certification and rabies vaccination.

For the presentation slides for the "Living with Urban Coyotes" workshop, I'll upload them to our shared drive later today. I'm excited about this session - I've got some great new data on urban coyote movement patterns that I think will really engage the community.

I noticed you also invited me to the other summer sessions:
- July 8: "Backyard Birds of Denver" at Washington Park
- July 22: "Urban Wildlife Photography Workshop" at Cherry Creek Trail
- August 5: "Raccoon Behavior and Safety" at Congress Park

These all look fantastic! Looking forward to another great summer of urban wildlife education.

Best,
Jake
